chapters.title: Embers in Oakvale
chapters.summary: Wolves test the palisade. Mira sends you to the smith with a sealed report.

chapters.title: The Darkwood Sickens
chapters.summary: The forest is rotting from the inside. Sela traces the blight toward the cave and the old stones.

chapters.title: Caves Below
chapters.summary: Goblins nest under Darkwood and hold a villager for something in the castle.

chapters.title: Quiet of the Grave
chapters.summary: Ruins name Malrik. The graveyard walks. The castle road unlocks.

chapters.title: The Blackthorn Curse
chapters.summary: The Warden falls. The necromancer and the Heart are silenced.
